claim_boundary: Feasibility-audit reflex-recovery-envelope measurement only: graded synthetic overshoot states are injected into the B2K2_final continuous-mu family (with dynamics randomization re-enabled) and two existing scripted reflex stacks (M3105 v4 incumbent, v5 candidate) plus a coast baseline are measured for recovery rate, recovery time and longitudinal cost. No driver promotion, deployment ranking, training, repair-success, gate-validity, paper, or self-ID capability claim is made.

harness_deltas: dynamics randomization re-enabled at library defaults (mu pinned per cell)
obstacle finish_on_pass=False (episode must not truncate mid-recovery)

injection_model.yaw: yaw_rate = kappa*v + o*mu*g/v (o x max sustainable yaw rate), cap 3.0 rad/s
injection_model.steer: front slip forced to -o x artanh(0.95)*mu*Fzf/cf within actuator limit
injection_model.brake: drive_force = -min(o*mu*Fzr, max_brake) (past the rear friction circle)
injection_model.heading: nose rotated into turn by 0.4 x slip depth; course drifts outward
injection_model.side: slide toward the OUTSIDE boundary; offset = initial |lateral_error|

recovery_definition.stalled: speed_too_low termination (stopped; safe-ish but NOT recovered)
recovery_definition.contained_drift: no terminal, ended inside marked corridor (|lat|<=2.5) with |beta|<=0.25: safe containment in a bounded persistent drift, but not clean stabilization
recovery_definition.save_rate: outcome in {recovered, contained_drift, stalled} (= did not crash)

drivers.baseline_coast: steer 0, no throttle, no brake (no-reflex control)
